title: Knowing Is Not Telling: Identity Ossification in LLM Representations of Trans-border Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Trans-border Identity Ossification Diagnostic Framework (TIODF) to pair binary factual knowledge probes with open-ended narrative prompts, which are then evaluated via a framing rubric to determine if the model compresses fluid trans-border ethnic identities into rigid, single nation-state categories.

Administering matched bilingual prompt batteries in English and Chinese to compare the frequency and severity of identity ossification across languages, supported by measuring cross-language semantic divergence using multilingual embeddings.
